scope: Saved-checkpoint consistency using existing cached features; no model fitting or fresh audio inference was performed in this audit.
completed_checks: Prediction JSON contains exactly dataset_A and dataset_B, with every test sample once and three distinct allowed label strings per sample.
Each selected candidate maximizes training-CV Top-1 + 0.5 * Top-3, breaking ties by Top-1 and fixed candidate order, across all 40 candidates.
Checkpoint dataset, canonical class labels, estimator class set, feature recipe, and training sample count match the saved metrics and manifests.
Reloaded checkpoints reproduce every saved validation ranking from cached features and exactly recompute all saved validation metrics and confusion matrices.
Reloaded checkpoints reproduce every submitted test ranking from cached features.
Acoustic and MERT comparison choices maximize their family training-CV criterion; their confusion matrix supports and Top-1 values agree with validation manifests.

fresh_wav_reproduction.note: A separate full fresh-WAV inference and exact prediction comparison is queued by the parent workflow. This audit does not establish waveform-level or cross-device reproduction.

decade_errors.interpretation: Most Top-1 errors (47 of 79, 59.49%) are between adjacent decades; this is an observed confusion pattern, not a causal attribution.

dataset_A.comparison_note: Selected hybrid validation Top-1/Top-3 is 40.15%/83.33%; MERT-only is 41.67%/79.55%. Selection was based on training CV, not these validation results.

dataset_B.market_error_note: US/UK contributes 10 of 60 Top-1 errors (16.67%), the largest pair but not a majority. US/Italy and UK/Spain each contribute 7. Brazil recall is 12/17; Spain recall is 4/17.
dataset_B.comparison_note: The selected model and the MERT-only comparator are the same training-CV-selected candidate.
